checks.label: Cash conversion
checks.line: Operating cash flow was 1.37 times net income.
checks.rule: Operating cash flow divided by net income, latest fiscal year. 1.0 or more: Pass. 0.8 to 1.0: Watch. Below 0.8: Fail.

checks.label: Accruals ratio
checks.line: Net income minus operating cash flow equals 2.2% of average assets.
checks.rule: Net income minus operating cash flow, divided by average total assets. Within plus or minus 5%: Pass. 5% to 10%: Watch. Above 10%: Fail.

checks.label: Stock based compensation
checks.rule: Stock based compensation as a share of revenue. Below 3%: Pass. 3% to 8%: Watch. Above 8%: Fail.

checks.label: Receivables versus revenue
checks.line: Receivables or revenue growth not computable.
checks.rule: Receivables growth minus revenue growth, latest year. Up to 5 points: Pass. 5 to 15 points: Watch. Above 15 points: Fail.

checks.label: One time items
checks.line: No restructuring or impairment charges tagged in the filings.
checks.rule: Restructuring, impairment and other one time charges as a share of operating income. Below 5%: Pass. 5% to 15%: Watch. Above 15%: Fail. None reported: Pass.

checks.label: Beneish M score
checks.line: One or more of the eight inputs not reported.
checks.rule: Beneish M score from eight reported ratios. Below minus 2.22: Pass. Minus 2.22 to minus 1.78: Watch. Above minus 1.78: Fail.

scorecard.label: Market risk
scorecard.rule: Worst of two reads on 5 years of daily prices. Annualised volatility: below 25% Low, 25% to 40% Medium, above 40% High. Largest fall from a peak: below 30% Low, 30% to 50% Medium, above 50% High.

scorecard.label: Financial risk
scorecard.rule: Net debt to EBITDA: net cash or below 1 Low, 1 to 3 Medium, above 3 High. A current ratio below 1 raises the level by one step.

scorecard.label: Business risk
scorecard.rule: From the concentration the company discloses. Any customer above 25% of revenue, or one region above 70%: High. Any customer above 10%, or one region above 50%: Medium. Otherwise, or nothing disclosed: Low.

scorecard.label: Legal and regulatory risk
scorecard.rule: From the legal proceedings section of the latest annual report. Matters the company itself calls material, or a regulator's decision or fine that is pending: High. Named pending cases without that language: Medium. None beyond routine matters: Low.
